title: Design-system profile
description: Everything the screen-building skills need to know about the design system a working Figma file uses. One profile per project, stored at .figma-deep-dive/design-system.json.

mode.description: library: a published design-system library is enabled in the working file and screens are built from its components, variables and text styles. local: no library; components, variables and text styles are authored in the working file and become the starting design system.

name.description: Display name used in reports, e.g. 'Acme DS'.

fileKeys.description: File key(s) of the published library file(s). A component belongs to the library when its main component is remote and comes from one of these files.

componentKeys.description: Optional: a few known component keys, used to resolve the library file key when fileKeys is empty.

foreignNameHints.description: Optional: component-name patterns (regex) that signal a different, unwanted library.

semanticCollections.description: Collections authored nodes must bind to.

primitiveCollections.description: Raw-value collections authored nodes must NOT bind to directly.

modes.description: Variable modes the file uses (themes, brands).

tokenPatterns.description: Name patterns per token family, e.g. color: 'color/{text|surface|border}/<name>'.

textStylePattern.description: How text styles are named, e.g. '<Family>/<px>/<Weight>'.

sizeLadder.description: Sizes the system offers; nearest-match snaps to these.

substitutions.description: Nearest-match rewrites for things the system lacks, e.g. {"Semibold": "Bold"}.

namePattern.description: How the library names components, e.g. 'Category/kebab-name'.

roles.description: Which library component fills a common role: primaryButton, secondaryButton, navigationBar, input, listItem, card, bottomActionBar, statusBar. Values are component names or keys.

localPagePrefix.description: mode local: prefix of the pages that hold authored components, e.g. '→ '.

renderWidth.description: Width source frames/renders are captured at.

screenBackground.description: Variable or style name for the default screen background.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the product copy, e.g. 'en', 'de-DE'.

proposedBanner.description: Text of the banner marking copy the build had to invent.

labels.description: Exact names of the scaffolding the build creates and the audit looks for.

legacyFlowNamespaces.description: Older namespaces to read (never write) so files built before a rename keep working.
